title: Counting frequencies of array elements
problemStatement: Count how many times each element appears in an array.
intuition: One pass: for each value, increment a map. Brute nested counting is O(n²) → TLE for n=1e5.

approaches.title: Brute: for each index recount
approaches.idea: For every i, scan j to count matches — or count only when i is first occurrence.

approaches.title: Optimal: hash map

commonMistakes: O(n²) nested loops on large n
Returning list of counts without mapping to values
patternRecognition: “How many times does X appear?” → frequency map
interviewInsight: Always contrast O(n²) brute with O(n) hash — easy complexity win.
